name: Mahou Kishi Arishia
source: War has broken out in one of the kingdoms of the magical world, Rooran. The events forced a member of the royal family to flee to Earth. Now she has to try blending in the society here, while also hunting down her enemies whom have followed her to this world and planning a counter-attack, to return to her home.
translation: War has broken out in one of the kingdoms of the magical world, Rooran. The events forced a member of the royal family to flee to Earth. Now she has to try blending in the society here, while also hunting down her enemies whom have followed her to this world and planning a counter-attack, to return to her home.
